RepoPrompt Portable release policy

- Release tags `v<version>`, `<version>`, and `sha-<full-commit>`, container digests, and GitHub release assets are immutable.
- `latest` is the only movable tag.
- Rollback moves `latest` only to a previously verified, signed digest; immutable release tags and assets are never replaced.
- A failed signature, attestation, checksum, SBOM, archive, or smoke verification blocks promotion. There is no unsigned fallback.
- A digest implicated in credential exposure is not releasable or rollback-eligible until the external credential owner confirms revocation or rotation. Repository checks cannot prove that operational step.
